DUOL.headline: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Duolingo, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
DUOL.description: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Duolingo, Inc. alleging that the company failed to disclose that increased user friction from ads and subscription upsells, combined with lower-quality AI-generated content, were negatively impacting daily active user growth rates. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased Duolingo securities between May 2, 2025 and February 26, 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 7, 2026.

DUOL.headline: Duolingo, Inc. Notice of December 7, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
DUOL.description: A class action securities lawsuit has been filed against Duolingo, Inc. for allegedly making materially false statements and failing to disclose that the company deliberately added friction to its user experience through increased ads and upselling, which harmed Daily Active User growth. The lawsuit also alleges that Duolingo's AI-generated content degraded product quality and user retention. DUOL.headline: Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. Notice of November 23, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
DUOL.description: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announced multiple class action securities lawsuits against publicly traded companies. Honeywell Aerospace faces allegations of failing to disclose supplier concentration risks, supply constraints, cybersecurity investigation, and making misleading statements about business prospects. The Ensign Group and Duolingo also have pending securities fraud lawsuits with application deadlines in December 2026.

DUOL.headline: Duolingo (DUOL) Q3 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
DUOL.description: Duolingo reported Q3 2026 revenue of $309.01 million, up 13.7% year-over-year and beating consensus estimates by 1.43%. However, EPS of $0.54 missed expectations of $0.55 by 1.82%. The company showed strong growth in subscription revenue (+17.6%) and user metrics, with DAUs reaching 64.9 million and MAUs at 153.1 million, both exceeding analyst estimates. DUOL.headline: Duolingo, Inc. (DUOL) Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates
DUOL.description: Duolingo reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.54 per share, missing the consensus estimate of $0.55, though revenues of $309.01 million exceeded expectations by 1.43%. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 33.1% year-to-date and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

YOU.headline: Clear Secure (YOU) Surpasses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
YOU.description: Clear Secure (YOU) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.63 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.56 and showing a 12.5% earnings surprise. Revenue reached $292.85 million, surpassing estimates by 2.22% and up 27.8% year-over-year. The stock has gained 36.2% year-to-date, outperforming the S&P 500's 10.6% gain. However, the company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

RYTM.headline: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals Announces NICE Guidance for IMCIVREE® (Setmelanotide) Updated to Include Adults Living with Bardet-Biedl Syndrome
RYTM.description: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals announced that the UK's National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has expanded its positive guidance for IMCIVREE (setmelanotide) to include adults with genetically confirmed Bardet-Biedl syndrome, allowing NHS funding for this patient population. The expansion builds on previous 2024 guidance that covered patients ages 6-17 and recognizes the significant burden of hyperphagia and obesity associated with the disease throughout adulthood.

RYTM.headline: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (RYTM) Reports Q3 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
RYTM.description: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals reported a Q3 loss of $0.61 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.68 loss, with a 10.29% earnings surprise. Revenue reached $92.13 million, surpassing estimates by 9.07% and nearly doubling year-ago revenues of $51.3 million. However, the stock has underperformed the market, down 12.7% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 10.2% gain. The company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions.

RYTM.headline: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals and LG Chem Enter into Amendment to Bivamelagon Exclusive License Agreement
RYTM.description: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals amended its global licensing agreement with LG Chem for bivamelagon, reducing royalties from low-to-mid-single digits to 1% on MC4R agonist sales while committing to $350 million in fixed payments over four years. The company also secured a $750 million term-loan facility led by KKR's HealthCare Royalty and Blackstone to support the agreement, commercialization efforts, and pipeline development.

PCOR.headline: Procore Technologies (PCOR) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
PCOR.description: Procore Technologies (PCOR) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.51 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.45, with revenues of $402.31 million exceeding expectations by 5.04%. However, the stock has declined 14% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 10.2% gain. The company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

LIVN.headline: LivaNova (LIVN) Surpasses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
LIVN.description: LivaNova (LIVN) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.23 per share, beating consensus estimates of $1.03 and delivering a 19.42% surprise. Revenue reached $393.1 million, surpassing estimates by 3.43%. The company has outperformed market expectations for four consecutive quarters. However, the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. The Medical-Instruments industry ranks in the top 43% of Zacks industries.

LIVN.headline: Waters (WAT) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
LIVN.description: Waters Corporation reported Q3 2026 earnings of $4.1 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.99, with revenues of $1.77 billion exceeding expectations by 0.81%. The company has consistently beaten estimates over the last four quarters. However, the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. Waters shares have gained 18.4% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 10.2% gain.

MOS.headline: MOS Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Higher Costs, Lower Volumes
MOS.description: The Mosaic Company (MOS) reported a Q3 2026 net loss of 23 cents per share, wider than consensus estimates, as net sales declined 10.2% year-over-year to $3.1 billion. Lower sales volumes across all segments and higher raw material costs pressured results, though the company beat revenue expectations. MOS expects continued cost pressures in Q4 2026 and revised full-year potash production guidance downward to 8.6 million tons due to lower ore grades.

MOS.headline: Mosaic (MOS) Q3 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
MOS.description: Mosaic reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3.1 billion, down 10.2% year-over-year, slightly beating the consensus estimate of $3.08 billion. However, the company posted an EPS of -$0.19, significantly missing the -$0.03 estimate. The stock has declined 10.6% over the past month and carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating, suggesting potential underperformance relative to the broader market.

MOS.headline: Mosaic (MOS) Reports Q3 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
MOS.description: Mosaic (MOS) reported a quarterly loss of $0.19 per share, significantly missing the consensus estimate of a $0.03 loss, representing a -533% earnings surprise. VRDN.headline: Arvinas, Inc. (ARVN) Reports Q3 Loss, Misses Revenue Estimates
VRDN.description: Arvinas (ARVN) reported a quarterly loss of $0.82 per share, slightly missing the consensus estimate of $0.80, with revenues of only $0.5 million versus expectations of $25.51 million. The company's stock has declined 36.6% year-to-date, significantly underperforming the S&P 500's 10.2% gain. The stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

XYZ.headline: Block's Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Cash App Lending & Square Growth
XYZ.description: Block reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.13, surging 109.3% YoY and beating estimates by 10.8%. Revenues grew 9.9% to $6.72 billion, driven by strong Cash App lending originations (up 40% to $19 billion) and Square GPV growth (up 14% to $76.4 billion). The company raised its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $4.15, projecting 75% YoY growth, with stock trading 10% higher in pre-market.

XYZ.headline: XYZ Q3 Earnings Call Highlights 2027 Outlook and AI Expansion
XYZ.description: Block, Inc. (XYZ) exceeded Q3 2026 earnings and revenue estimates with adjusted EPS up 109% and gross profit rising 22%. The company raised its 2026 outlook and provided 2027 targets, projecting 15% gross profit growth and 30% adjusted operating income growth with a 32% margin. Square's GPV grew 14%, Cash App lending surged 40%, and Block expects initial AI revenues in Q4 2026.

XYZ.headline: Block (XYZ) Q3 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
XYZ.description: Block reported Q3 2026 revenue of $6.72 billion, up 9.9% year-over-year and beating consensus estimates by 1.5%. EPS of $1.13 significantly exceeded the $1.02 estimate by 10.78%. Most operational metrics met or slightly exceeded analyst expectations, though Bitcoin ecosystem revenue declined 8.3% year-over-year. The stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

XYZ.headline: Block's Adjusted Profit Jumps as Losses Climb: Rapid Earnings Reaction
XYZ.description: Block reported strong third-quarter results with gross profit growing 22% and raising full-year guidance, driven by Square's accelerating U.S. payment volume growth and improved operational efficiency from workforce reductions. However, GAAP results reveal concerning trends: loan losses surged 66% and the company faced $435 million in legal charges for the third consecutive quarter, offsetting adjusted profit gains.

XYZ.headline: GPN's $40B Takeover Buzz: Can Private Equity Revive Its Growth?
XYZ.description: Private equity firms Clayton, Dubilier & Rice (CD&R) and GTCR are exploring a potential $40 billion leveraged buyout of Global Payments Inc. The transaction could be among the largest LBOs in history. While private ownership could accelerate Worldpay integration and operational efficiencies, integration complexities, increased debt, and competitive pressures remain concerns. RIOT.headline: Riot Platforms, Inc. (RIOT) Q3 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
RIOT.description: Riot Platforms reported Q3 2026 revenue of $181.43 million, beating consensus estimates by 12.37%, with EPS of $0.01 versus an estimated -$0.34. Bitcoin mining revenue declined 27.9% year-over-year to $115.99 million, though engineering revenue surged 146.2%. The stock has underperformed the broader market, declining 25.9% over the past month, and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

ADT.headline: ADT: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
ADT.description: ADT has agreed to be acquired by private equity firm Thrive Holdings for $10 per share in cash, representing a 46-52% premium to recent trading prices. The deal values ADT at $7.6 billion and is expected to close in Q1 2027, pending regulatory approval. ADT reported strong operational performance with year-to-date free cash flow exceeding $1 billion through three quarters, and announced new partnerships including installation and service support for Apple Retail and expansion to Walmart.com.

AEHR.headline: Aehr Test Systems: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
AEHR.description: Aehr Test Systems raised its fiscal 2027 revenue guidance to $150 million after Q1 revenue tripled year-over-year to $33 million. The semiconductor test equipment manufacturer is benefiting from AI processor demand and has expanded its customer base to 12+ accounts with a record backlog of $109.3 million, reducing reliance on single customers and providing strong revenue visibility.

CIFR.headline: Why Cipher Digital Stock Lost 53.9% in October
CIFR.description: Cipher Digital stock plummeted 53.9% in October due to AI sector financing concerns and an $850 million convertible debt offering that spooked investors. The company faces heavy borrowing needs ($6.7 billion debt) to fund its data center expansion, though it has $16.6 billion in contracted revenue with long-term leases. Key risks include construction cost pressures, Texas regulatory scrutiny, and a challenging credit environment that may limit future lease signings.

CIFR.headline: CIFR Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Growth Plans and Cost Pressures
CIFR.description: Cipher Digital (CIFR) extended its Barber Lake lease to 20 years, lifting contracted revenues to $9.1B and restoring a 15% yield. The company is advancing engineering designs to 30-60% completion before executing new leases to mitigate construction inflation and labor pressures. With $16.6B in contracted revenues across three campuses and a 5.9-GW development pipeline, CIFR maintains a selective development strategy focused on creditworthy tenants and risk-adjusted returns.

HUT.headline: Circle Internet Gears Up to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in Store?
HUT.description: Circle Internet Group (CRCL) is set to report Q3 2026 earnings on Nov. 4 with projected revenue growth of 8.36% to $801.61 million, but EPS is expected to decline 37.5% to 40 cents per share. While USDC adoption and the Hyperliquid deal could provide support, lower reserve yields and higher operating expenses are pressuring profitability. The stock has a negative Earnings ESP of -17.97%, suggesting an earnings miss is more likely.

HUT.headline: Sezzle Set to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
HUT.description: Sezzle Inc. is expected to report Q3 2026 results on November 4 with revenues and EPS projected to rise 31.83% and 80.28% year-over-year, respectively. The company benefits from subscriber growth, higher transaction frequency, and new merchant partnerships. However, higher credit losses and lower revenue yield may offset gains. The Zacks model does not predict an earnings beat due to a -3.53% Earnings ESP despite a Rank #2 rating.

HUT.headline: Remitly Set to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
HUT.description: Remitly Global (RELY) is set to report Q3 2026 results on November 4, with expected revenues of $505-507M (20-21% YoY growth) and 10.5M active customers. The company has consistently beaten earnings estimates and shows strong momentum in digital money transfers, though transaction losses and elevated marketing costs pose risks. The quantitative model does not predict an earnings beat this quarter.

HUT.headline: Dave Q3 Earnings Coming Up: What to Expect From the Stock?
HUT.description: Dave Inc. is projected to report Q3 2026 revenues of $191.15 million (up 26.76% YoY) and EPS of $4.45 (up 4.95% YoY) on November 4. Growth is expected from higher member activity, ExtraCash originations, and improved monetization. However, increased marketing and AI spending may limit operating leverage. The company's quantitative model does not predict an earnings beat despite a Zacks Rank #2 rating.

HUT.headline: Hut 8 Set to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
HUT.description: Hut 8 Corp. is set to report Q3 2026 results on November 4, with revenues expected to decline 9.1% year-over-year to $75.9 million. While strong bitcoin mining operations at Vega and Drumheller may support activity, elevated mining costs and interest expenses from $7.5 billion in project financing could pressure profitability. The company has an Earnings ESP of +24.67% and Zacks Rank #3, suggesting potential for an earnings beat.
